title: catalog.custom_field_change_resolved v1
description: FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape). A pending custom-field change that a staff member asked the staff agent for without catalog:custom_fields:write (ADR-183 D6) reached its end: approved and applied, approved but not applied because the value had changed since the request (double read, D3.3), rejected, expired or cancelled (ADR-179 approval.decided/expired/cancelled). Published by alebrije-mod-catalog-go (internal/service/custom_field_changes.go, from its events:approvals consumer and its reconciler, which re-publishes a resolved change without notified_at) on the events:notifications stream, not on the EventBus: like agentic.staff_report.answered it travels in the notification-trigger envelope that notifications-ex Events.Pipeline consumes (the stream field `payload` holds this JSON object), so this schema describes that flat object. Pipeline reads event_name; event_type carries the same constant for this registry (ADR-31). origin is "system" because Pipeline's OriginGuard accepts only human, system or synthetic, and synthetic would suppress the whole event; the QA marker travels only in payload.qa_origin. notifications-ex Workers.CustomFieldChangeResolvedWorker delivers it to subscriber_id (whoever asked): always in the bell, and by WhatsApp (template reporte_atendido) in the requester's branch hours, only to a QA WhatsApp when qa_origin. Nothing clinical travels: the catalog item, the field, the value before and after.

event_type.description: ADR-31 event type, the same constant as event_name.

event_name.description: The key notifications-ex Events.Pipeline routes on.

subscriber_id.description: Whoever asked for the change (the same value as payload.requester_user_id): who receives the result.

origin.description: Pipeline OriginGuard origin; never synthetic (that suppresses the event).

payload.description: How the pending change ended and where to deliver it.

change_id.description: catalog.custom_field_changes id: the subject of the approval.

approval_id.description: The ADR-179 approval request of the change.

field_label.description: The custom field's label (e.g. «Para quién es»).

before.description: The value when it was requested (null = empty).

after.description: The value that was requested (null = empty).

requester_name.description: Who asked, by name (≤80), when the staff agent knew it.

requester_phone.description: E.164 of whoever asked, when the request came by WhatsApp.

requester_context_id.description: The requester's branch: its clock decides the WhatsApp hours.

conversation_id.description: The requester's chat with the staff agent.

qa_origin.description: True when the request came from a QA phone: the result only reaches a QA WhatsApp.

decided_by_user_id.description: Who decided the approval; null when it expired or was cancelled.
